optimizedContext.value:
# Slice Guide Content

## Rules

- Pure application layer, zero external runtime deps. All line numbers 1-indexed.
- `GetGuideSectionQuery(catalogPort: GuideCatalogPort)`; wraps `GetGuideQuery`. Input `{ topic: string, section: string | number }`.
- Topic resolve: `trim()` → strip trailing `.md` → `toLowerCase()`. No slugify, no `:` split. `catalogPort.getGuide(normalized)` = exact `GUIDES_INDEX` dict lookup, so `collection:topic` keys (`core:ports`, `code-graph:services`) survive verbatim. Empty or not found → `GuideTopicNotFoundError` (`UNKNOWN_GUIDE_TOPIC`, `availableTopics`).
- `section` is a SEPARATE field from `topic`; topic `:` never reaches section matching.
- Numeric branch: `typeof section === 'number'` OR string matching `/^\d+$/` on `section.trim()`. Anchored digits-only ⇒ any `:`-bearing string is NOT numeric. Then `parseInt(section.trim(), 10)` + `outline.find(s => s.index === idx)`; miss (incl. `0`, negative, oversized, non-integer) → `GuideSectionNotFoundError`. CLI `--section` is unparsed ⇒ always string ⇒ only regex branch reachable from CLI.
- Heading/slug branch: hit when `heading.toLowerCase() === section.trim().toLowerCase()` OR `toSlug(heading) === toSlug(section)`; `toSlug` = lower → trim → strip `[^\w\s-]` → `[\s_-]+`→`-` → trim `-`. 1 hit → return; >1 → `GuideSectionAmbiguousError` (`AMBIGUOUS_GUIDE_SECTION`, `matchingIndices`, `matchingHeadings`); 0 → `GuideSectionNotFoundError` (`UNKNOWN_GUIDE_SECTION`, `availableHeadings`).
- `content` sliced on the fly: short-circuit when `section.content !== undefined`; else `content.slice(startOffset, endOffset)` if both set, else `split(/\r?\n/).slice(startLine-1, endLine).join('\n')`. Spans heading line → `endLine` inclusive; nested `###` subheadings kept, next peer heading excluded.
- `sliceGuideLines(content, startLine?, lineCount?)`: `startLine` undefined or `< 1` → 1; `startLine > total`, `lineCount <= 0`, or falsy content → `""`; `lineCount` omitted → slice to EOF; normalize `\r\n`/`\r` → `\n`; oversized `lineCount` clamps to EOF, no padding, no throw.
- `formatWithLineNumbers(content, startLine?)`: falsy → `""`; each line → `` `${n} | ${line}` `` with `n` from `startLine < 1 ? 1 : floor(startLine)`; width = `String(baseLine + lines.length - 1).length`; `padStart` right-aligns so `|` columns align.

## Constraints

- Line numbers and `section` indices 1-indexed; never 0-based.
- Ambiguous heading MUST throw, never silently take first match; duplicates resolvable only by numeric index.
- Error codes fixed: `UNKNOWN_GUIDE_SECTION`, `AMBIGUOUS_GUIDE_SECTION`, `UNKNOWN_GUIDE_TOPIC`.
- Pure utils MUST NOT throw on out-of-range input; return `""`.

## Drift (spec text vs code)

- verify.md scenario 1 invokes `execute({ topic, sectionHeading })`; real field name is `section`.
- Numeric-miss `availableHeadings` is `` `${index}: ${heading}` ``; by-name miss passes bare `heading`. Spec documents only bare form.
- Out-of-range index enforced by `find` miss, not an explicit `index < 1 || index > total` bounds check (same error surfaced).
- `GUIDES_INDEX` holds 22 keys, zero containing `:` ⇒ `collection:topic` addressing is NOT yet live; adapter lookup is exact-key, so `core:ports` resolves to null until generated keys carry the collection prefix.
- Empty `topic` in `GetGuideQuery` throws `GuideTopicNotFoundError` listing all topics (spec only covers "topic not found").
